mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usage_records (price_snapshot, finalized, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, attempt_id, source, session_uuid, session_external_id, api_key_uuid, user_uuid, model, started_at, ended_at, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, cache_write_5m_tokens, cache_write_1h_tokens, search_requests, model_cents, model_cost_usd, search_cents, complete, version) VALUES (#{record.PriceSnapshot}, #{record.Finalized}, #{record.OrganizationUUID}, #{record.WorkspaceUUID}, #{record.AttemptID}, #{record.Source}, #{record.SessionUUID}, #{record.SessionExternalID}, COALESCE(#{record.APIKeyUUID}, (SELECT s.created_by_api_key_uuid FROM sessions s WHERE s.organization_uuid = #{record.OrganizationUUID} AND s.workspace_uuid = #{record.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.uuid = #{record.SessionUUID})), #{record.UserUUID}, #{record.Model}, #{record.StartedAt}, #{record.EndedAt}, #{record.InputTokens}, #{record.OutputTokens}, #{record.CacheReadTokens}, #{record.CacheWriteTokens}, #{record.CacheWrite5mTokens}, #{record.CacheWrite1hTokens}, #{record.SearchRequests}, #{record.ModelCents}, #{record.ModelCostUSD}, #{record.SearchCents}, #{record.Complete}, #{record.Version}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid, source, attempt_id) DO UPDATE SET model = EXCLUDED.model, ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, cache_read_tokens = EXCLUDED.cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens = EXCLUDED.cache_write_tokens, cache_write_5m_tokens = EXCLUDED.cache_write_5m_tokens, cache_write_1h_tokens = EXCLUDED.cache_write_1h_tokens, search_requests = EXCLUDED.search_requests, model_cents = EXCLUDED.model_cents, model_cost_usd = EXCLUDED.model_cost_usd, search_cents = EXCLUDED.search_cents, complete = EXCLUDED.complete, finalized = EXCLUDED.finalized WHERE NOT usage_records.finalized
mapper.select: SELECT e.uuid, e.external_id, e.organization_uuid, e.workspace_uuid, e.session_uuid, e.session_external_id, e.thread_uuid, e.thread_external_id, e.event_type, e.payload, e.payload_blob_uuid, e.tool_use_id, e.processed_at, e.created_at, e.deleted_at FROM session_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'span.model_request_end' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_records u WHERE u.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND u.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND u.source = 'managed_agents' AND u.attempt_id = e.external_id) ORDER BY e.created_at, e.uuid LIMIT #{limit}
